name: Turks and Caicos Islands
prevalence_note: The TCI Financial Services Commission has urged the public to stay vigilant against scam calls that spoof official bodies and ask for banking details or transfers.
cross_border_note: Turks and Caicos (+1-649) uses NANP numbering, so spoofed caller IDs showing local or US numbers are hard to spot.

scams.name: Spoofed police or FSC call
scams.name_en: Call spoofing police or the Financial Services Commission demanding bank details
scams.signals_en: A caller claims to be from the FSC or police, alleges an account problem and asks for bank details or a transfer.
scams.legit_en: The FSC urges the public to stay vigilant and not to hand banking details or money to unverified callers.
bait_tactics: Ask for the officer's name and FSC department, then ask for it spelled out
Say every bank matter is settled in person at the Providenciales branch
